credentialFreeLiveProof.method: the case boots a FRESH dsh process in an isolated DSH_HOME with a throwaway key and a local OpenAI-shaped stub that answers the PARENT model step with exactly one mpd_role_spawn call; a sandbox copy of the shared adapter is instrumented so the restriction actually handed to the harness is recorded

credentialFreeLiveProof.whyItProvesTheFix: tools.restrict() runs inside the child's setup, so a rejection means no child agent is created. A created, answering child proves the harness accepted the seven-name list, and the adapter probe pins which list was accepted.

correctionToTheProposedSignal.proposed: failing with MISSING_CREDENTIAL instead of the restrict error is positive evidence the list was accepted, because restrict() runs at child composition before model authentication
correctionToTheProposedSignal.measured: REFUTED. Authentication precedes the child's composition. Lane A (no key) stops at `MISSING_CREDENTIAL: llm-deepseek: no API key for provider route "deepseek-official"` and lane B (dummy key) stops at `AUTH: Authentication Fails` — in both cases mpd_role_spawn is never invoked, so the restriction is never evaluated and the credential error carries no information about the list.
correctionToTheProposedSignal.consequence: the credential-free stub lane above is the strongest live evidence available here; the credential lanes are recorded as diagnostics only and are deliberately NOT listed as verify entries
